method: Heterogeneous chunks:4B VLM64 and Qwen3-1.7B dense reasoner32 versus16/16. Original BF16/FP32 kernels, same budgets/images.
motivation: WS08 car screen passed, but first prospective broader worker failed text preservation. Dense full-attention prefill32 may have a better activation/attention tradeoff than64. This is an exploratory hypothesis, not a causal explanation of WS08 regression. Do not adopt WS08 or retry it unchanged.
tradeoffs: Larger VLM activation/cache footprint; reasoner32 cache smaller than64 but more chunk submissions. Both policies remain warm/shared-weight in the ablation. No quantization or output cache.
stage: Prepared only while mirrored WS08 worker completes. No build/GPU validation/timing until that process terminates. Then native/reference and all32VLM/28reasoner state/token checks before fixed-car WorldSense ABBA screen/four measured samples per policy/model. Fresh full three-frame/search mirrored workers required for promotion.
telemetry: Identical control/candidate prompt SHA-256 and effective capacity/pixels/output limit are recorded. Prompt equality and unchanged non-chunk budgets are additional correctness gates; this telemetry is part of WS09 source before any timing.
